_readme: Valuation assumptions for value_tracker.py. Edit and refresh the page; no restart needed.
base = normalized owner earnings per share (FCF minus stock comp, or clean EPS where capex is distorting FCF), in the stock's trading currency.
g1 = annual growth years 1-5, g2 = years 6-10, tg = terminal growth, r = discount rate (required return).
fair_pe = fair multiple on forward earnings (cross-check). bear_eps x bear_pe = the bad-case price (used for downside).
required_mos = margin of safety needed before the tracker says BUY ZONE. Weighting: 60% DCF, 40% multiple.
Assumptions written 2026-11-11. They are estimates, not facts. Revisit after every earnings report.

stocks.name: Uber Technologies
stocks.driver: Stay the demand aggregator as robotaxis scale (AV supply runs through Uber, not around it)
stocks.black_swan: A vertically-integrated AV fleet (Waymo/Tesla) with its own app takes the dense, profitable cities and leaves Uber the low-margin rest
stocks.moat: Two-sided network + Uber One; 20% bookings growth at scale; lowest cost of demand in mobility/delivery

stocks.name: Alphabet
stocks.basis: 2027E clean EPS (ex investment gains); FCF temporarily ~0 from ~$200B capex
stocks.driver: Google Cloud + TPU monetization turning the 2026-27 capex wave into FCF of $60B+ by 2028
stocks.black_swan: AI assistants break the search-ads auction (lower monetization per query) while capex stays elevated: margin + multiple compress at once
stocks.moat: Search distribution, YouTube, TPUs, Cloud; $130B net cash

stocks.name: Meta Platforms
stocks.basis: 2027E EPS; FCF went negative in Q3-26 on $135-145B capex
stocks.driver: AI-driven ad pricing/engagement keeps revenue growth >15% long enough to absorb the depreciation wave
stocks.black_swan: Capex with no ROI (superintelligence bet) + youth-safety regulation/ad-targeting bans in US/EU; owner has 'never sell' control so no capital-discipline check
stocks.moat: 3.5B+ daily users, best ad-targeting engine, 81% gross margin

stocks.name: Heineken (EUR)
stocks.basis: Free operating cash flow ~EUR 2.8B to equity / 558M shares (dividend ~2.3%)
stocks.driver: Premiumization + EverGreen cost cuts lifting operating margin from ~14.5% to 17% with low-single-digit volume
stocks.black_swan: Secular decline in alcohol (GLP-1 drugs, Gen-Z abstention) turns flat volumes into -2%/yr while EM currencies (Nigeria, Brazil, Mexico) devalue
stocks.moat: Global #2 brewer, distribution scale, brand portfolio; ND/EBITDA 2.6x

stocks.name: Pentair
stocks.basis: 2026 adj EPS guide midpoint after July cut ($4.60-4.80); ~100% FCF conversion
stocks.driver: Cyclical turnaround: pool destocking ends and 2027 returns to $5.30+ EPS with 25%+ segment margins
stocks.black_swan: Pool is not destocking but a structural demand reset (housing freeze + high rates) and pricing power breaks; new management credibility gap (CFO exit)
stocks.moat: Installed-base pool equipment (aftermarket ~80%), pricing discipline, 24% ROS target

stocks.name: Brookfield Asset Mgmt
stocks.driver: Fee-bearing capital compounding 12-15%/yr (infra, AI power/data centers, Oaktree credit, insurance)
stocks.black_swan: Private-credit/real-asset valuation crisis: redemptions freeze, fundraising stalls, carry disappears and the 28x 'toll-road' multiple de-rates to 18x
stocks.moat: Asset-light fee stream, $682B fee-bearing capital, long-dated locked capital

stocks.name: MercadoLibre
stocks.basis: Normalized EPS (between TTM $37 and 2027E $54); FCF negative because the $16B loan book is growing 75%/yr
stocks.driver: Op. margin recovering from 6% back to 10%+ once Brazil free-shipping/logistics and card-loss spending normalize, while revenue keeps growing 30%+
stocks.black_swan: Credit cycle in Brazil/Mexico/Argentina: card NPLs spike while Amazon/Shein/Temu force permanent margin give-backs; ARS/BRL devaluation
stocks.moat: LatAm #1 marketplace + Mercado Pago + own logistics network; revenue +45-50%

stocks.name: Nu Holdings (Nubank)
stocks.basis: Run-rate EPS (Q2-26 net income $1.06B, ROE 33%); Q3-26 not yet reported. Growth/discount set conservatively because a bank must retain capital to grow
stocks.driver: Mexico & Colombia reaching Brazil-like profitability while keeping 30%+ ROE
stocks.black_swan: Brazilian consumer-credit crisis (household debt + Selic shock) or a BRL collapse; regulatory caps on card interest
stocks.moat: Lowest cost-to-serve bank in LatAm, 100M+ customers, digital-only

stocks.name: Kaspi.kz (ADS)
stocks.basis: USD EPS (Q3-26 net income $637M); ~70% paid out as quarterly dividends
stocks.driver: Turkey (Hepsiburada) becoming a second Kazakhstan without diluting group returns
stocks.black_swan: Kazakhstan/Russia sanctions spill-over, tenge devaluation, or the state turning on a dominant private super-app
stocks.moat: Kazakhstan super-app monopoly (payments, marketplace, fintech); ROE ~45%

stocks.name: Pavilion REIT (MYR)
stocks.basis: Distribution per unit FY26E ~10.1 sen (100% payout); fair_pe = price/DPU, i.e. a 6.25% fair yield
stocks.driver: Rental reversion at Pavilion KL + hotel contributions growing DPU 2-3%/yr
stocks.black_swan: Malaysian rates rise / ringgit weakens while KL prime retail oversupply cuts rents; related-party acquisitions funded by dilutive placements
stocks.moat: Owns Pavilion KL, the top mall in Bukit Bintang; P/NAV ~1.1x

stocks.name: LVMH (EUR)
stocks.driver: China/aspirational-shopper recovery bringing Fashion & Leather back from -5% to +6-8% organic
stocks.black_swan: Luxury loses pricing power permanently after 2021-24 price hikes (brand fatigue, China wealth effect broken); succession after Bernard Arnault
stocks.moat: Louis Vuitton/Dior/Tiffany/Sephora portfolio, op. margin ~22% even at the cycle low

stocks.name: S&P 500 (SPY)
stocks.basis: SPY share of fwd S&P EPS (~$33) x 85% owner-earnings payout; fair_pe applied to owner earnings
stocks.driver: Mega-cap AI capex converting into earnings; buybacks
stocks.black_swan: Concentration: top 10 = ~40% of index; an AI capex bust hits the index harder than ever before
stocks.moat: Diversified; the hurdle every pick must beat

stocks.name: Microsoft
stocks.basis: FY27E EPS; FCF compressed by AI capex

stocks.name: Adobe
stocks.basis: FCF/share ~ $24 less SBC; 8.6x fwd EPS = market pricing AI disruption
stocks.driver: Firefly/GenAI keeps creative pros + enterprise on Creative Cloud
stocks.black_swan: Generative tools commoditize design software: seat count shrinks

stocks.name: S&P Global
stocks.driver: Ratings issuance + index fees on passive flows

stocks.name: Berkshire Hathaway
stocks.driver: Deploying $370B cash at good returns post-Buffett
